about.description: STRCon is an Ondo Global Markets tokenized exposure designed to provide economic exposure to Strategy Inc Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) in an onchain format. The token is designed to be fully backed by the underlying publicly traded asset, together with cash in transit, held with regulated custodial broker-dealers. Holdings attestations and ongoing reporting are surfaced through Ondo trust and transparency materials and the product asset page. Tokenholders are not shareholders of the underlying and do not receive shareholder voting rights. Dividend value is reflected through total return mechanics. Ondo Global Markets adjusts the token to account for dividends net of withholding taxes and reinvests that value into additional shares, increasing the shares per token over time instead of paying cash dividends directly to tokenholders.
about.registryInfo: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited issues Ondo Global Markets tokens as structured notes designed to track the performance of the corresponding underlying publicly traded stock or ETF (including dividends, which are reinvested where applicable). The notes are governed by the Issuer’s Sales Terms under Swiss law. GM tokens are fully backed 1:1 by the corresponding underlying securities held with regulated custodial broker-dealers, plus an additional collateral buffer. Ondo publishes ongoing attestations and reporting for GM token backing (verified by Ankura Trust Company).
